scenario.recruiter: time-constrained independent recruiter returning to a relationship after source authorization ended
scenario.trigger: Two source-linked external effects remain in history: one verified completion and one timeout with no destination observation.
scenario.job_to_be_done: See that follow-up is required from Chat, distinguish the unknown result from the completed result, and understand the next human decision without treating authorization loss as an undo operation.
scenario.success_condition: Chat stays usable, one compact link opens the living-page review, the unresolved effect appears first, both effect states remain explicit without relying on color, and no control retries or changes an external destination.
scenario.pressure_limit: This review covers an authenticated responsive Web build with synthetic evidence. It does not establish native iOS behavior, field comprehension, production connector reconciliation, adoption, or willingness to pay.

frozen_evidence: Authenticated local relationship URL for person 36f2a44f-7404-4d90-a45b-ad4ac2e8cd51 and context fd1aeff1-6745-4ac3-8996-bb727abf89c1
Direct browser interaction at 1440 by 1000 pixels in light mode
Direct browser interaction at 390 by 844 pixels in light and dark modes
Browser DOM snapshot with one unresolved result, one verified completed result, exact destination and evidence fields, and no external-action control
23 Web test files and 102 tests passing
Successful Next.js production build with 22 generated routes

review_plan.reason: The placement and compression determine whether a rushed recruiter can recover the real next decision.
Unknown and completed external effects must remain distinct after source authority ends.
Chat history, the composer, bottom navigation, and long effect metadata compete for a narrow viewport.
The artifact does not assess, compare, rank, score, or recommend candidate quality.
The reviewed slice exposes no candidate-facing communication or external execution control.

strengths: Chat carries only the operational signal and one link instead of embedding two dense audit cards in the narrow Agent column.
The living person page owns the structured effect review, preserving the product distinction between task interaction and durable relationship understanding.
The unresolved result appears first and says to reconcile before retrying, while the verified completion explicitly remains recorded.
Expanding six Agent-history events on desktop leaves the composer visible.
One Chat link opens the exact review section instead of asking the recruiter to search the page.

findings.observation: The synthetic direct review makes the two states and next human response legible, but no working recruiter has yet interpreted the screen under real call-preparation pressure.
findings.user_impact: The workflow is coherent and executable, while the time saved, terminology fit, and perceived importance remain assumptions.
findings.recommendation: Run a five-minute comparison using consented real cases that include one verified send and one ambiguous connector result.
findings.verification: Without coaching, recruiters identify which effect needs reconciliation, which one must not be repeated, and what they would check next; measure time, errors, and willingness to reuse.

reviews.lens: external-effect truth, authorization, provenance, and action boundaries
strengths: The unknown card contains no invented destination observation and does not collapse timeout into failed.
The completed card preserves the verified external observation and states that authorization expiry did not undo it.
Both cards expose destination, latest evidence, attempt state, and the authorization-expiry time.
Unknown and completed use explicit labels, explanatory copy, icons, and borders rather than color alone.
No retry, contact, destination-edit, or execution control is present; the footer requires a new recruiter decision.

reviews.lens: responsive task completion, hierarchy, touch access, and visual state
strengths: At 390 by 844 pixels, Agent remains the first viewport and the labeled bottom navigation keeps People and Sources reachable.

The initial expanded-history implementation pushed the composer under the bottom navigation; the corrected history now scrolls within a bounded region and leaves the composer and Ask Agent control visible.
The Chat link scrolls directly to the external-effect review at the narrow viewport.
Cards reflow to one column, long synthetic destination keys wrap without horizontal overflow, and metadata labels stack above their values.
Light and dark review states preserve readable warning and completed semantics.

findings.observation: The responsive browser run covered visual reflow, direct navigation, expanded history, and dark mode, but not VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, software-keyboard avoidance, safe-area variants, background recovery, or native iOS capture handoff.
findings.user_impact: The Web slice is usable at a representative narrow viewport, while assistive and native-device edge cases remain unproven.
findings.recommendation: Run the same relationship on the smallest supported iPhone and at large accessibility text sizes, including keyboard entry, VoiceOver order, background and resume, and screenshot intake return.
findings.verification: The user reaches both states, hears their evidence and next decision in order, keeps the composer above the keyboard and home indicator, and resumes without duplicate or lost state.

adjudication.resolved_finding: The populated mixed-effect review has now been directly inspected at desktop and narrow responsive widths, including expanded Agent history, exact-section navigation, long destination keys, unresolved-first ordering, verified completion, and light and dark modes. The mobile composer-overflow defect found during review was corrected and retested.
adjudication.release_boundary: This passes the local responsive Web presentation of mixed external effects. It does not pass the whole multichannel product, native iOS accessibility, production connector reconciliation, or field and commercial value.
adjudication.next_highest_risk_test: Put the same completed-plus-unknown case in front of working independent recruiters and observe whether they identify the correct reconciliation and non-retry decisions without coaching.
